name: @lenso/process-protocol
description: Language-neutral Process Protocol types and conformance helpers for Lenso Execution Adapters.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && bun build src/index.ts --target=node --format=esm --outdir=dist --entry-naming='[name].js' && bun build src/index.ts --target=node --format=cjs --outdir=dist --entry-naming='[name].cjs' && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
